provenance.prompt:
Create a new pixel-art game animation sheet for Butterfree-Gmax, using this image as the exact identity, palette, camera and layout reference. Transparent background, exactly eight columns and four rows, wide empty transparent gutters; no text, no scenery, no effects. Preserve all anatomy, form and visible parts.
Each row has a fixed camera: row1 SOUTH/front (face visible), row2 EAST/right profile (points right), row3 NORTH/rear (back visible, face hidden), row4 WEST/left profile (points left). Never turn the character toward the camera during an animation. The NORTH row must show only the back; do not draw a front face there.
Columns1-4: four distinct, expressive flinch poses for a cartoon game impact: surprised wince, lowered head with tense/braced body, sustained closed-eye wince, return to ready stance. Columns5-8: four distinct resting-on-ground poses: knees/body lower, limbs fold as body settles sideways/down, fully flat with closed eyes, final still-flat resting pose. Last two columns must clearly show a prone body on the ground, with characteristic wings/tails/flower/markings intact. This is a nonviolent family video game: no injury, blood, wounds or damage marks. Keep consistent pixel scale, hard-edged pixel clusters and limited original palette. Each full-body sprite must be complete and remain inside its cell. Actual redraws of body and limbs rather than rotated or resized standing copies.
provenance.shiny_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: a complete 32-pose 8x4 pixel-art reaction atlas. Image2 is ONLY the shiny color reference. Recolour image1 to exactly match image2. Keep broad wings MINT-GREEN/CREAM-WHITE and head/body VIOLET with all original veins and wing patterns. Change the eyes to shiny GREEN. Keep red/pink clouds and body accents. No yellow wing borders or green body. CHANGE COLOURS ONLY. Preserve every exact physical pose, rigid body volume, appendage count, 4 fixed row headings, all 32 figures in 8 columns and 4 rows, common scale, hard pixel clusters, transparent alpha zero outside sprites and wide gutters. Preserve the lying poses and all original silhouettes. No background, effects, text, labels, smoothing, clipping or redesign.
